# Optimizer360

> Optimizer360 (optimizer360.ai) is the AI-native organic marketing company. Tagline: "Own your growth." It makes brands found, trusted, followed, talked about and chosen across AI answers, search, media and communities, using its own platform (Optimizer GEO) plus six specialist teams. Home market India; also the United States and Mauritius. Contact: abhay@optimizer360.ai

Key facts: tracks 8 AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, Microsoft Copilot, Google AI Overviews), up to 10,000 prompts per brand per day. Method: Scan, Diagnose, Fix, Prove, measured against each client's Week-1 baseline. In one real-estate programme the visibility score rose from 32% to 58% across eight engines in under 2.5 months. Optimizer360 never names clients and never promises rankings. Works in 10 industries.

## Solutions

- [Six things you should own.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/): Optimizer360 is an organic marketing agency in India that builds six growth assets you own: AI visibility, reviews, media, community, chat agents, pipeline.
- [Get named in the answer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo/): GEO agency in India. Generative engine optimisation services that get your brand named and cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- [Accuracy, not spin.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo-investor-relations/): Investor relations GEO for listed companies in India. We keep what AI tells investors accurate and current, using public disclosures only, within SEBI rules.
- [Be trusted before the call.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/reputation/): Online reputation management in India for the AI era: real reviews, public replies, fact corrections and press that shape your brand reputation in AI answers.
- [Build the roads in.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/feeder-network/): Build an owned media network of feeder sites, channels and earned media that sends buyers your way and gives AI engines independent brand mentions to trust.
- [Get talked about.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/content-community/): Community-led growth for brands: communities you host, Reddit and Quora answers posted openly as the brand, content agents and digital PR that earn real talk.
- [Answer every buyer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/ai-agents/): AI chat agents for lead qualification on your website, WhatsApp and Instagram. They answer accurately, qualify buyers and book calls or visits, day and night.
- [Fund what actually works.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/leads-pipeline/): Organic lead generation with attribution for AI search. We trace each deal to the AI answer, review, thread or video where demand began, so you fund what works.
- [See what AI says.](https://optimizer360.ai/platform/): Optimizer GEO is our AI visibility tracking platform. It runs up to 10,000 prompts per brand a day on 8 AI engines, tracking brand mentions, sources and fixes.

## Guides

- [AI search, explained.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/): Plain guides to generative engine optimisation: how AI engines pick sources, GEO vs SEO, Reddit and Wikipedia, and how to measure AI visibility.
- [GEO, explained plainly.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/what-is-generative-engine-optimisation/): Generative engine optimisation (GEO) explained: how AI engines build answers, the levers that get your brand named and cited, and how to measure it.
- [SEO still counts. GEO builds on it.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/geo-vs-seo/): GEO vs SEO explained: how ranking pages differs from being named in AI answers, where the two overlap, and why SEO still matters. With a comparison table.
- [Who the engines listen to.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/how-ai-engines-choose-sources/): How does ChatGPT choose sources? What studies from Profound, Semrush, Peec AI and Ahrefs show about how AI engines pick the brands they recommend.
- [Show up openly. Never fake it.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/reddit-wikipedia-ai-visibility/): An ethical playbook for Reddit, Wikipedia and Wikidata: how brands can show up in the sources AI engines cite most, without astroturfing or paid edits.
- [Measure the answer, not the hope.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/measure-ai-visibility/): How to measure AI visibility: visibility score, citation rate, AI share of voice and sentiment, built on a prompt universe, a Week-1 baseline and drift checks.
- [Investors ask AI. Is it right?](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/ai-answers-investor-relations/): What does ChatGPT say about your listed company? Why AI answers to investors go stale, and how IR teams can correct them using public disclosures only.
- [GEO terms, in plain words.](https://optimizer360.ai/glossary/): A plain GEO glossary: 28 terms on generative engine optimisation and AI search, from citation rate and visibility score to llms.txt, E-E-A-T and drift.
- [Questions, answered plainly.](https://optimizer360.ai/faq/): Answers about GEO and Optimizer360: how it differs from SEO, engines we track, timelines, pricing, pilots, compliance, ethics and why we never name clients.
